question: In the weightlifting event at the 38th National Games, what was Mehak Sharma’s total lift that earned her the gold medal and set a new national record?
solution:
The correct answer is __**247 kg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mehak Sharma**, representing the host state of **Uttarakhand**, secured the **gold medal** in the **women's +87 kg** weightlifting category during the **38th National Games**.
 
• She achieved a total lift of **247 kg**, which not only earned her the top spot on the podium but also established a **new national record** in this weight class.
 
• The record-breaking performance included a successful lift of **107 kg** in the **Snatch** segment and a powerful **140 kg** lift in the **Clean and Jerk** segment.
 
• Her total of **247 kg** surpassed previous benchmarks, highlighting the rising standards of Indian weightlifting at the domestic level.
 
• This feat was achieved in the presence of sports enthusiasts and officials, marking a significant milestone for **Uttarakhand** sports history. ***Hence, the correct answer is 247 kg.***
